certification.name: Fortinet Network Security Specialization
certification.description: Five-course Fortinet specialization covering the core Fortinet network security products and how to design, deploy, administer and support an enterprise security infrastructure with them. Course-based certificate with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 weeks at 10 hours a week.
